description:
Changes settings from get_parameters on a running database. Each value is a number in the setting's unit (ms, kB, or as is), "on" / "off" for booleans, or null to go back to Postgres' default. Settings left out keep their value.

Applied by reload, without a restart, and read back: if Postgres doesn't take a value, the old settings stay. A timeout applies to every session of the database, so a short statement_timeout can cancel the application's own long queries. Returns an actionId; poll get_action until "Success" or "Failure".

changes.description: Setting name → new value, or null for the default

confirm_name.description: The exact instance name, as a guard against acting on the wrong one. Call get_instance first and copy it from there.

id.description: Instance id, as returned by list_instances

name: set_parameters
title: Change a PostgreSQL database's settings
